caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man in a naval uniform attached to the front part of a ship's bow or figurehead. The man has brown wavy hair and sideburns, and is shown facing forward with a neutral expression. He is dressed in a dark blue double-breasted military-style coat with gold buttons and gold epaulets on the shoulders, a red sash across his chest, a high white collar, and a white cravat or neckcloth. The bust is set atop a wooden structure resembling a ship's prow, which is colored in a pale, weathered white with carved details and two projecting horizontal pieces on either side. A thick, yellowish-brown rope is wrapped around the lower part of the bust and tied at the front. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present in the composition.
title: Commodore Morris Figurehead
